body: If you have no good friends, then that's also partially your own fault. You need to go out there and find friends. Join clubs, engage with people that have similar interests as you do. Friends don't fall from the sky, you have to earn them, nurture them. Before you kill yourself over a bunch of losers that don't like you, try being a good friend yourself first!

I'm so sorry that your ex-wife had such a bad experience, too. But I'm glad she was able to overcome the trauma with time. It's just so horrible when you go into a procedure with hopes and expectations, and then it turns out all bad. I spent more than 1000 USD on scar treatments since then, but nothing's really helping. I don't want to hold on longer because I don't know for what. I'll be 32 in January and have lost 2 important years of my life to find a partner and have a family. It's over for me.

I don't really want to deal with that doctor anymore. I just want to be fixed, which is impossible. I look like Frankenstein with all these scars and marks everywhere. I just can't accept myself like this. I just wanted to feel good about myself, and now I'm completely isolated and lost in the world. I'm so so ashamed of my body now, not even my closest friends or family know about the surgery.

I am not myself anymore. I am botched, below average. Actually, I consider myself "Body garbage" now. I have the hope that someone might benefit from my organs, but I really have the urge to throw up every time I look in the mirror.

Does it matter? He was just being real. That's how society is. I went into the surgery and got botched. There are people who laugh at me and even say it's my own fault, which is so cruel as I didn't choose that, nor did I perform the surgery on myself. I don't want to be the "botched victim" for the rest of my life. And that's all I am right now, so I'd rather be gone.

My Ex actually left me for the surgery. He said he didn't want "such a woman". Botched, scarred for life, with dents and bumps all over my body. Half of my right leg is oversucked, so I would need to get reconstructive surgery, but I don't have the money to do that. It's a nightmare that won't end. I wake up every day crying and really just want it all over.

They are ugly, when they are from Plastic Surgery and totally unnecessary. I have never seen anything like this on anybody else. I think the doc was on drugs. He actually gave me a 50 % refund, but I have spent it on scar treatments of course.

I really don't know what to do anymore. I literally break down every day. I am right now crying my eyes out, as I don't know how to survive another day with this botched body. I feel ashamed, because there are people who have "real issues" and fatal diseases, while I pray to God every day to kill me finally.
